epics.title: Decisions needed
epics.goal: Get named owners to answer the open questions so blocked stories can proceed; no owner has been named or has answered yet. Story set approved by Saloni Sharma.

stories.title: Decide the risk rule set and owner
stories.description: As the compliance owner I decide which risk scoring rules, country list and rating thresholds apply, and who maintains them, so that one rule set is built.
acceptance_criteria: Given the scoring module and the case page disagree (High at 6 vs 7, different country lists) When the owner reviews both Then one rule set with points, thresholds and country list is recorded in the spec as BR-001 to BR-003.
Given the decision is not made When engineering plans the scoring stories Then those stories stay blocked and no thresholds are guessed.

stories.title: Decide approval policy and Quick approve
stories.description: As the compliance owner I decide whether Low-risk cases auto-approve, whether Quick approve exists, who may reject or escalate, and whether four-eyes applies, so that decision permissions are defined.
acceptance_criteria: Given the queue has a Quick approve that skips role and risk checks When the owner decides Then the spec records keep or remove, and the approval matrix and four-eyes rule for BR-004 and BR-010.
Given Q-002 is unanswered When routing stories are planned Then they remain blocked and no auto-approval is built.

stories.title: Decide blocked-case handling and review cycle
stories.description: As the compliance officer I decide what happens to sanctions-blocked cases and how the review cycle (1, 2, 3 years) is used, so that these flows are specified.
acceptance_criteria: Given a case is blocked When the officer decides Then the spec states who reviews, releases or reports it.
Given the review cycle is confirmed or changed When the spec is updated Then BR-007 and whether reminders are needed are stated.

stories.title: Decide screening provider and identity provider
stories.description: As the tech lead I choose the sanctions/PEP provider with its matching logic and the identity provider with its role mapping, so that integrations can be built.
acceptance_criteria: Given no provider is chosen When the tech lead decides Then IN-001 and IN-002 name the systems, matching method and role mapping.
Given a provider is unavailable When the decision is recorded Then the failure behaviour (hold, never treat as no match) is confirmed.

stories.title: Decide data, access and operations policy
stories.description: As the business owner I decide required fields and formats, admin powers, report and export access, retention, ID re-check, jurisdictions, availability and the legacy page, so that data and access rules are fixed.
acceptance_criteria: Given these questions are open When the owner answers them Then Q-008 to Q-014 are closed in the spec with named owners.
Given an answer is missing When dependent stories are planned Then they stay blocked.

epics.title: Foundations
epics.goal: A deployable service skeleton and database schema for the stories to build on.

stories.title: Service skeleton, CI and secrets handling
stories.description: As an engineer I have a service skeleton with build, tests and secret-store configuration so that features can be built safely.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repository When CI runs Then build and tests pass.
Given the source code When it is scanned Then no credential or token is present, and missing secrets cause startup failure rather than defaults.

stories.title: Database schema for cases, audit, screening, rules and users
stories.description: As an engineer I have the schema for DM-001 to DM-005 so that features can store data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an empty database When migrations run Then all tables exist with keys and constraints.
Given a migration is run twice When it is re-applied Then it is a no-op without error.

stories.title: Consistent error handling
stories.description: As a user I see a plain message when something fails and no data changes so that I can retry safely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a save fails midway When the error is returned Then the user sees a plain message and no partial case exists.
Given an unexpected server error When it occurs Then no personal data appears in the message or logs.

epics.title: Security and audit
epics.goal: Authenticated access, server-side authorisation, and a complete audit trail.

stories.title: Sign in with the identity provider
stories.description: As a user I sign in via the organisation's identity provider so that only staff access the app.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am not signed in When I open any page or API Then I am sent to sign in and see no data.
Given the identity provider is down When I try to sign in Then I am refused with a message and no local fallback account exists.

stories.title: Server-side role enforcement
stories.description: As the firm I want every request checked against the user's role on the server so that screen tricks cannot bypass permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given an analyst When they call the approve API for a case Then the request is refused.
Given a changed browser state When a user sends a forged role Then the server ignores it and uses the identity provider role.

stories.title: Audit trail of status changes
stories.description: As a compliance officer I see who changed each case, when and why so that decisions are accountable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a case status changes When the change is saved Then an audit event with actor, time, old and new status and note exists.
Given an audit event When anyone tries to edit or delete it Then it is refused.

stories.title: Protect personal data and escape displayed text
stories.description: As the firm I want personal data protected and user text escaped so that data is not leaked or run as code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a name containing script text When a page shows it Then it is displayed as text and not executed.
Given the logs and the database When inspected Then ID number and date of birth are not in logs and are protected at rest.

epics.title: Risk rules and scoring
epics.goal: One agreed risk calculation used everywhere.

stories.title: Configurable risk rules
stories.description: As a compliance owner I maintain the country list, points and thresholds outside the code so that rules change without a release.
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner updates the country list When saved Then a new rule version is recorded with who and when.
Given a non-owner When they try to change rules Then it is refused.

stories.title: Calculate score and rating
stories.description: As an analyst I get a score and rating for each case so that it is routed correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the confirmed rules When a case is scored Then score and rating match the agreed table, including at each threshold boundary.
Given a case already rated When rules change Then its stored rating keeps its rule version and the same rating shows on queue, case and report.

stories.title: Next review date
stories.description: As a compliance officer I see when a customer must next be reviewed so that reviews are not missed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a decided case When the rating is High, Medium or Low Then the next review date is the confirmed years after the decision date.
Given a case not yet decided When shown Then no review date is displayed.

epics.title: Capture customer
epics.goal: Analysts can create validated, screened cases.

stories.title: Create a case with validation
stories.description: As an analyst I create a case so that a customer can be onboarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid form When I submit Then the case is saved with my name and time.
Given a missing required field, an age under 18 or an expired ID When I submit Then I get a clear message and nothing is saved.
Given a date of birth exactly 18 years ago today When I submit Then it is accepted.

stories.title: Screen names against sanctions and PEP sources
stories.description: As an analyst I want each new customer screened so that sanctioned and PEP customers are caught.
acceptance_criteria: Given a name matching the sanctions source When a case is created Then the screening result is stored and the case is blocked.
Given a PEP match and a declared non-PEP When created Then the case is marked PEP.
Given the provider is unavailable When a case is created Then it is held as screening unavailable, never as no match.

stories.title: Ad-hoc name screening
stories.description: As any user I check a name without creating a case.
acceptance_criteria: Given a name When I screen it Then I see sanctions and PEP results and the check is recorded.
Given an empty name When I screen Then I am asked to enter one.

stories.title: Route new cases and block sanctions matches
stories.description: As the firm I want new cases blocked or routed to the right approver so that risk gets proper review.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sanctions match When the case is created Then status is blocked and it cannot be approved.
Given a non-blocked case When created Then it is pending_review for the approver of its rating, with no automatic approval unless decided otherwise.
Given a status outside the allowed list When set Then it is refused.

epics.title: Review cases
epics.goal: Approvers see the queue and record decisions within their authority.

stories.title: Review queue with counts
stories.description: As a reviewer I see all cases and counts so that I can work the queue.
acceptance_criteria: Given cases exist When I open the queue Then I see total, awaiting decision, High and blocked counts and a table with status and rating.
Given no cases When I open the queue Then I see an empty state, not an error.

stories.title: Case detail page
stories.description: As a reviewer I see all details, screening and history of a case.
acceptance_criteria: Given a case When I open it Then I see customer data, stored rating, screening result and decision history.
Given an unknown case id When I open it Then I see not found and no data.

stories.title: Approve, reject or escalate with a note
stories.description: As a permitted approver I decide a pending case and give a note.
acceptance_criteria: Given a High case and a senior analyst When they try to approve Then it is refused (matrix as confirmed).
Given a pending case and a permitted approver When they approve with a note Then status, decider, time and note are saved and audited.
Given no note When submitting Then the decision is refused, and a creator deciding their own case follows the four-eyes decision.

stories.title: Blocked sanctions case handling
stories.description: As a compliance officer I handle blocked cases in the agreed way.
acceptance_criteria: Given a blocked case When I open it Then I see the agreed actions only for my role.
Given an unauthorised role When trying to release Then it is refused.

epics.title: Reports
epics.goal: Authorised users report on and export cases safely.

stories.title: Case report with rating filter and CSV export
stories.description: As an authorised user I filter cases by rating and export CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Given the rating filter When I select High Then only High cases are listed with the same rating as elsewhere.
Given a name starting with a formula character When exported Then it is escaped, the export is audited, and unauthorised roles are refused.

stories.title: Verify performance and accessibility targets
stories.description: As the business I want the app to meet agreed speed and accessibility targets.
acceptance_criteria: Given a load test with expected users When run Then 95 percent of requests meet the confirmed target (proposed 2 seconds).
Given an accessibility scan and keyboard test When run Then no WCAG 2.1 AA failures remain.
